text.clean: Hello. Our finance contact is on leave this week; her colleague is covering any questions. We have moved our remittance advice emails to a new mailbox at the same domain. Our billing desk will be closed on Friday afternoon for a software upgrade. Regards, Ana (North Pier Supply)
text.neutral:
Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from North Pier Supply. Please be aware that the billing desk is shut on Friday afternoon while software is upgraded. Remittance advice from us will now arrive from a new mailbox on our usual domain. While our finance contact is away this week, a colleague is answering questions on her behalf.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Ana
North Pier Supply
--
This message was sent from a shared mailbox.
